app.name: WiiKart
app.long_description: Semi-sim racing over eight circuits, including seven stylized Colorado mountain passes with real grades, switchbacks, cliffs, and gravity. Eleven fallible AI rivals use different strategies and driver personalities, learn from mistakes, and adapt without rubber-banding. Cars, game settings, and keyboard/GameCube/Xbox control guidance are editable in documented JSON files. Naturally aspirated, turbocharged, and supercharged engines each behave differently, with boost managed by the driver instead of collected on the course. Includes lap timing and a live leaderboard, a marshal helicopter for driving the wrong way, an optional Dolphin input translator, per-track lap counts, garage, manual gearboxes, tire strategy, staged cliff recovery, up to 4-player split screen, and procedural audio. Supports Wii Remote, Nunchuk, Classic Controller, GameCube pads, Xbox pads through Dolphin, and USB keyboard. Runs on Wii hardware and in Dolphin.
